text.tspan: Air pollutant emissions United Kingdom, 1970 to 2016
Annual emissions of nitrogen oxides (NOx), non-methane volatile organic compounds (VOCs) and sulphur
dioxide (SO₂) measured in tonnes per year. This is measured across all human-induced sources.
